boundedPointRelationAuthorization.reason: Reuses the reviewed BeginResourceRelationRead owner and the point resource authorization reader for the related endpoint, keeping the literal viewer-then-key order (the relation row must name the decoded source ref exactly, the related endpoint must pass the source predicate, and a miss revalidates access). Its only caller, boundedPointResourceDecision, is reached from the escaped point route (boundedPointResourceAuthorization) and from the fallback point shape (boundedFallbackAuthorization: PATCH/DELETE .../relations/{relationId}). Certified on this branch: TestScaleP21SW327EscapedResourceAuthorization (400 legacy/bounded pairs over the principal and key matrix, witness, private related, reversed and raw-alias relations for projects and initiatives, SQL-reloaded rows) and TestScaleP21SW491FallbackAuthorizationDifferential (3304 warm and reloaded pairs including public/private relation PATCH and DELETE, slug mismatch and missing relation IDs), with TestScaleP21SW255PointResourceAuthorization and TestScaleP21SW490AuthorizationFallbackClosure pinning the route shapes; all with zero full decodes and released work.
